name: infiniFi USD
oneLiner: IUSD is infiniFi's USDC-collateralized dollar stablecoin, with reserves deployed duration-matched across institutional private credit and liquid DeFi lending.
collateral: USDC; deployed across institutional private credit strategies (Fasanara, Sentora, FalconX, Maple) and liquid DeFi markets (Spark, Fluid, Aave), duration-matched to user lock-up periods
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint/redeem against USDC with no fees; on-chain fractional reserve — liquid portion available for instant withdrawals, illiquid portion deployed to time-locked institutional lending strategies; redemptions queue when liquid reserves are insufficient

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: infiniFi publishes an Ethereum iUSD ReceiptToken, a direct LayerZero OFT on BNB Chain, and a Tempo TIP-20 iUSD with an OFT Adapter. The Tempo adapter's lock/unlock side is the weakest documented durable cross-chain route, so the profile uses external-lock-mint. The issuer-listed Plasma address is excluded because pinned on-chain metadata identifies it as iUSDT rather than iUSD.

protocols.name: infiniFi iUSD multi-network deployment inventory
protocols.note: The issuer lists the BNB iUSD OFT and Tempo TIP-20 iUSD OFT Adapter. Its Plasma label conflicts with the address's pinned iUSDT metadata, so that address is not accepted as an iUSD deployment.

protocols.name: LayerZero OFT / OFT Adapter
protocols.note: LayerZero documents direct OFTs as burn/mint and the default OFT Adapter as a token-locking adapter.

sources.label: infiniFi contract addresses (Tempo TIP-20 iUSD and OFT Adapter)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The accepted deployment inventory includes Ethereum ReceiptToken 0x48f9e38f3070ad8945dfeae3fa70987722e3d89c, BNB OFT IUSD 0x60B14ec49874Af1BA471685cb11132101aeBdF09, and Tempo TIP-20 IUSD 0x20c000000000000000000000AB02D39df30bd17E with OFT adapter 0xfA339b5a3AD03fd9Ff048F574636b60d0FC7538A. The issuer-listed Plasma address is excluded because pinned metadata identifies it as iUSDT, not iUSD. At Ethereum block 25534201, the verified ReceiptToken deployment was unpaused and its source has no transfer hook or holder blacklist. At BNB block 110030607, verified InfiniFiOFT source exposed standard OFT/ERC-20 transfers without a pause ABI. At Tempo block 30008157, TIP-20 IUSD reported paused() = false and transferPolicyId() = 1, while its official specification permits PAUSE_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE transfer-policy changes, and BURN_BLOCKED_ROLE burns of policy-blocked balances; the OFT adapter resolved token() to TIP-20 IUSD and owner() to the infiniFi Safe. Route role membership and Tempo adapter source were not fully enumerable, so a global no-freeze/no-restriction conclusion is unsupported.

mintAuthority.summary: IUSD receipt-token minting is gated by RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER in the infiniFi Core. Four protocol contracts hold the role; only YieldSharing is upgradeable. Mint-role administration, ReceiptToken core replacement, and YieldSharing upgrades all require the 4-of-7 admin Safe to schedule an action through a seven-day timelock.

controls.label: infiniFi MintController
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527135, Core role enumeration returned MintController 0x49877d937b9a00d50557bdc3d87287b5c3a4c256 as a RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER. It is a direct non-proxy deployment.

controls.label: infiniFi mint path proxy (TransparentUpgradeableProxy)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527135, Core role enumeration returned YieldSharing proxy 0x90e91f5bfd9a0a4d925bf30b512add8cd2bbae3b as a RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER. Its ProxyAdmin is owned by the seven-day infiniFi Timelock.

controls.label: infiniFi PLSmoother
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527135, Core role enumeration returned PLSmoother 0xc324569141697045b9ede54b5d4623a691ed57a4 as a RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER. It is a direct non-proxy deployment.

controls.label: infiniFi MigrationController
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527135, Core role enumeration returned MigrationController 0x5f5403656e4db95accf1064a714b1bce351839f8 as a RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER. It is a direct non-proxy deployment.

controls.label: infiniFi admin Safe (PROPOSER_ROLE + MINOR_ROLES_MANAGER)

routeChecks.signingModel: The 4-of-7 Safe is the Timelock's sole proposer; no enabled Safe modules or transaction guard were detected.
routeChecks.rateLimits: RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER administration, ReceiptToken.setCore calls, and YieldSharing proxy upgrades initiated by this Safe must traverse Timelock 0x3d18480cc32b6ab3b833dcabd80e76cfd41c48a9 with getMinDelay() = 604800 seconds.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The Safe is not a Core GOVERNOR and does not own ProxyAdmin directly. The Timelock holds GOVERNOR and owns ProxyAdmin 0x094227ee5e9c3877860ac212f1e5218441e5b4eb.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527135, RECEIPT_TOKEN_MINTER's admin was GOVERNOR. Safe 0x80608f852d152024c0a2087b16939235fec2400c had MINOR_ROLES_MANAGER but not GOVERNOR; direct Safe grantRole/revokeRole calls reverted requiring GOVERNOR, and ReceiptToken.setCore reverted UNAUTHORIZED. Timelock 0x3d18480cc32b6ab3b833dcabd80e76cfd41c48a9 held GOVERNOR, had getMinDelay() = 604800, and the Safe was its sole proposer. YieldSharing ProxyAdmin 0x094227ee5e9c3877860ac212f1e5218441e5b4eb was owned by that Timelock; a direct Safe upgrade call reverted as unauthorized.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527135, ReceiptToken 0x48f9e38f3070ad8945dfeae3fa70987722e3d89c, Core 0xf6d48735eccf12bdc1df2674b1ce3fcb3bd25490, MintController 0x49877d937b9a00d50557bdc3d87287b5c3a4c256, PLSmoother 0xc324569141697045b9ede54b5d4623a691ed57a4, and MigrationController 0x5f5403656e4db95accf1064a714b1bce351839f8 were direct non-proxy deployments. YieldSharing 0x90e91f5bfd9a0a4d925bf30b512add8cd2bbae3b was a transparent proxy with implementation 0x0d5dbf208a9a7540018d204a9a0ad08a091407e5 and ProxyAdmin 0x094227ee5e9c3877860ac212f1e5218441e5b4eb. The 4-of-7 Safe had no immediate GOVERNOR or ProxyAdmin-owner path: mint-role administration, ReceiptToken core replacement, and YieldSharing upgrades all converged on Timelock 0x3d18480cc32b6ab3b833dcabd80e76cfd41c48a9 with a 604800-second minimum delay.

reserveReview.rationale: The real-time farm snapshot names and quantifies every material farm position. The source descriptions establish each position's published strategy and redemption terms; no material basket requires an assumed constituent allocation.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unresolved material composition group remains: the only non-farm protocol position is RedeemController, whose source-total reconciliation gap is below the adapter's 0.5% threshold.
